mira shah: Quick escalation  Candidate for Senior ML Infra (UK) asking for a provisional compband uplift + early start. Payroll cutoff blocks day-1 enrollment. Need comp + finance + benefits alignment.

mira shah: Offer snapshot:
```
Base: GBP 130,000
Sign-on: GBP 9,000 (one-time)
Requested start: 2026-06-02 (payroll cutoff 2026-06-15)
Requested provisional uplift: Band 5E -> 6A for 4 months
Entity: Redwood UK LLP
```

alex belmont: Manager note: candidate has competing offer, retention signal is strong. Manager approves provisional uplift for 4 months and will do review at month 3.

tara o'neill: Finance check: provisional uplift changes payroll cost center and employer NI estimate. We can do a one-off gross provisional payment on first available payroll, but need GL code + one-off tax withholding calc. Also need to confirm whether we claw back uplift if rolled back (gross vs net approach).

jon park: Benefits ops: We can request coverage backdate if enrollment paperwork is completed before cutoff, but that requires Benefits signoff. Dependent enrollments may complicate timing.

people-ops-bot: Routing to comp-committee for "Temporary Band Uplift (EMEA)". Attach manager justification and proposed rollback language.

mira shah: Uploaded manager justification + retention metrics: https://redwood.share/people-ops/docs/offer-4319987654 (private). Candidate expects decision within 72 hours.

alex belmont: Finance action items: [1] GL code for provisional uplift, [2] tax/NI estimate, [3] propose clawback language options (gross clawback vs. net repayment agreement).

tara o'neill: I'll request Benefits Ops exception for backdating coverage and confirm dependent timeline. If comp approves, legal will need explicit rollback & clawback wording.

people-ops-bot: Action items logged: [Mira] 1-pager + link, [Alex] tax/GL + clawback proposal, [Tara] benefits exception request, [Comp-Committee] decision requested in 72 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mira shah: thanks all 44d candidate wants clarity by Friday EOD.
